actual_settings.prompt:
Edit this exact source video into ONE coherent EAST-facing full-body running-and-firing animation of the SAME VIYA. The input is the accepted slow-motion running gait; retain its exact timing, leg trajectories, alternating foot plants, push-offs, leg recovery and toe clearance, original root, body size, framing and fixed camera. Every output instant must correspond to the SAME gait phase in the input. Keep both boots visible.

Make a clear but restrained change to the FULL-BODY pose: she is actively aiming and firing her ORIGINAL rune-decorated rifle while running. Firm two-handed grip, one hand supporting the fore-end and trigger hand gripping the stock, the original long barrel pointing EAST/right nearly horizontally, held slightly higher and more firmly than the input carry. Show subtle anatomically coherent shoulder, elbow and rifle recoil-and-recovery, with controlled torso movement. Preserve her lower-body running motion and root throughout; do not restart the gait with each shot. Do not leave the running pose unchanged. Do not add muzzle flashes, bullets, smoke, cartridge cases, sparks or any visible firing effects; those are supplied by the game.

Preserve exactly her mature adult face and proportions, long dark-brown wavy hair, ivory top, fitted black corset, partial gloves, brass/gold ornaments, short lower garments, thigh straps, bare upper thigh regions, tall original decorated boots, asymmetric crimson cloth and SAME slim original rune-decorated firearm. Preserve every asymmetric detail, painted dark-fantasy anime style and continuous hair/cloth motion. No redesign, sleeves, replacement armor, extra clothing, new weapon, extra limbs, or mirrored details.

This is a seamless gait cycle for a sprite game. The final distinct pose must lead naturally into the first as consecutive phases. Keep the exact source's source-time gait and last-to-first continuity. Do not duplicate the first pose at the end, ping-pong, freeze the legs, crossfade, ghost, assemble cutout body parts, or warp the body. Keep the source's fixed full-body root and ground plane; no camera zoom, rotation, pan or reframing. Render full complete character in every frame. Keep the flat saturated green background from the input completely uniform. No shadow, scenery, text, logos, floor line or other characters. Silent video. Preserve sharp painted hands, boots and weapon structure. The game will separately retime this slow-motion master to its accepted approximately 0.66-second gait cycle.
